يعتذروا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَذِرُوا (yaʕtaḏirū) /jaʕ.ta.ði.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# يُعْتَذَرُوا (yuʕtaḏarū) /juʕ.ta.ða.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
